name: bk_exp10_operand
title: Operand digits at '=' are decodable by a probe, yet no edit there changes the model's answer
caption: Left: 5-fold cross-validated linear probes on the layer-42 activation at '=' for 600 bare 'a +/- b =' prompts (external prompt set), accuracy per digit slot with Wilson 95% intervals; exact operands 0.83 / 0.95. Right: 117 one-digit few-shot items the model answers 100% correctly; centred edits at '=' along the digit's class mean or a magnitude direction (+/-, 0.11 and 0.22 of the norm), a 9-dim class-mean swap, and a whole-vector donor patch; share of greedy answers that change, Wilson 95%. Caveat: even the donor patch flips 1 of 117, so the '=' site at layer 42 cannot show causal use; 'unused here' is a property of the site, not proof the model ignores operand identity.

checks.quantity: flips across steered direction/swap rows (one-digit bank)

notes:
Probe accuracy recomputed from the stored CV predictions in gate.json against the operands in arithmetic.jsonl. Flips recomputed from g4_raw.pt greedy answers vs the unsteered 'none' condition (r11 and r22, + and - pooled per direction). The donor-patch count comes from the aggregate stage2a_g4b.json (flip_rate x n); its raw file is not local. J-removed = top-1536 J-space projected out. Several raw conditions failed the leak test (mag_raw, swaps VOID per RESULTS) but flips are zero regardless. Few-shot example: '68 + 85 = 153
97 - 23 = 74
78 - 34 = 44
1 + 1 ='.
